[[:File:Undead Prince Rurik (aura).jpg|View image with boss aura]] | affiliation = Undead | type = Zombie | profession = Warrior | boss = y | level = 28 (30) | campaign = Prophecies }} [[Undead Prince Rurik]] is the reanimated corpse of [[Prince Rurik]], who met his demise at the end of [[The Frost Gate]]. The [[Lich Lord]] brought him back from the dead to serve him, and he meets with his old allies near the end of [[Hell's Precipice]], where he is bound to the lich's will and is commanded to kill the players. You can also see him in the cinematic for [[Thunderhead Keep]], at the end. The players fight Rurik and defeat him, giving his soul peace. It is likely he has earned a place in [[the Hall of Heroes]]. ==Missions== * [[Ring of Fire Islands]] ** {{NPC location|Hell's Precipice}} ==Skills== 16 [[Tactics]] *{{skill icon|Deadly Riposte}} *{{skill icon|Final Thrust}} *{{skill icon|Hundred Blades}} ([[elite]]) *{{skill icon|Thrill of Victory}} ==Armor ratings== {{NPC statistics | prof = w | blunt = 139 | piercing = 139 | slashing = 139 | cold = 119 | earth = 119 | fire = 119 | lightning = 119 }} ==Items dropped== *[[Bone]] *[[Decayed Orr Emblem]] *[[Executioner's Breastplate]] *[[Pile of Glittering Dust]] ==Notes== {{anomaly|Unlike most other ''Prophecies'' [[boss]]es, Undead Prince Rurik does '''not''' have [[Natural Resistance]].}} *Although Prince Rurik is undead in this form, [[holy damage]] does not deal extra damage to him, though the use [[of Deathbane]] weapons does affect him. *This NPC has a [[miniature]] [[Miniature Undead Prince|version]]. *Undead Prince Rurik has a [[Everlasting Prince Rurik Tonic|tonic form]].
